meta.name: kevstig coverage snapshot (KA-002, routed slice)
meta.provenance: Real API data; ROUTED-ONLY slice (156 of the API's 273 routed) built from the fetch spill (the body's tail was torn by the 750KB fetch cap, so later/older rows never arrived). Counts stay the live numbers; the entries = the decoded routed rows verbatim; feeds the KA-029 expansion queue.

entries.description: The kernel in Microsoft Windows contains a vulnerability that allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
entries.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when components of Windows, .NET Framework, Office, Lync, and Silverlight fail to properly handle TrueType fonts.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
entries.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel-mode driver improperly handles TrueType fonts.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel fails to properly handle objects in memory.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Graphics Device Interface (GDI) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: The Graphics Device Interface (GDI) in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Search Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows allows an attacker to take control of the affected system when Windows Search fails to handle objects in memory.

entries.name: Cisco IOS XR Open Port Vulnerability
entries.description: Cisco IOS XR software health check opens TCP port 6379 by default on activation. An attacker can connect to the Redis instance on the open port and allow access to the Redis instance that is running within the NOSi container.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in the way that the Windows Kernel handles objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code with elevated permissions.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Information Disclosure Vulnerability
entries.description: An information disclosure vulnerability exists in the way that the Windows SMB Server handles certain requests, which could lead to information disclosure from the server.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: A local elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in how splwow64.exe handles certain calls. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could elevate privileges on an affected system from low-integrity to medium-integrity.

entries.name: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
entries.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability that can occur when manipulating JavaScript objects due to issues in Array.pop, allowing for an exploitable crash.

entries.name: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
entries.description: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a sandbox escape vulnerability that could result in remote code execution.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Extensions Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows AppX Deployment Extensions improperly performs privilege management, resulting in access to system files.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) improperly handles hard links.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows User Profile Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows User Profile Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

entries.description: Microsoft Windows User Profile Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability which allow for privilege escalation.

entries.name: Microsoft Windows CLFS Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
entries.description: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

entries.name: Apple macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
entries.description: macOS Monterey contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an application to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

entries.name: Apple macOS Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
entries.description: macOS Monterey contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow an application to read kernel memory.
